name: Restaurant Equipment Wholesale
old_description: “Our Everyday Goal:  Support and provide services to all of Hawaii commercial customers with the Best Value quality products, family like customer care and KOKUA”
about:
Restaurant Equipment Wholesale, doing business as R.E.W. Restaurant Equipment Wholesale, Inc., operates from Honolulu, Hawaii. The company supplies commercial kitchen equipment and related products to foodservice businesses across the Hawaiian islands.

The wholesaler stocks a range of equipment categories, including refrigeration and freezing units under the Turbo Cooling & Freezing line. Its service model emphasizes local delivery within Hawaii and round-the-clock customer support, with a membership program that provides additional discounts on purchases.

Customers include independent restaurants, hotel foodservice operations, institutional kitchens, and other commercial food preparation facilities throughout the state. The company focuses on the Hawaii market, tailoring its inventory and logistics to the geographic constraints of island-based operations.

The business promotes a value proposition built on competitive pricing, personalized service described as “family like customer care,” and the Hawaiian concept of kokua—mutual assistance. Its local delivery network and 24/7 availability are positioned as key differentiators for operators who need rapid equipment replacement or urgent support.
